citizen_question: I rent a room in Sundarpur Civil Lines. Someone said there is a new rent help scheme. Can I apply now?
resolution: Shahari Kiraya Sahayata Yojana has been announced but is not open yet. Applications will open on 2027-01-15 (15 January 2027) and close on 2027-03-31 (31 March 2027). It gives ₹3,000 per month for rent, for up to 12 months, to urban households with an annual income of ₹1,50,000 or less. Keep a registered or notarised rent agreement, a recent income certificate and your bank passbook ready. Nobody can register you before the opening date, and there is no fee.
